name: project_points_perspective
description: Projects fifty three-dimensional points from a table onto the screen with a perspective divide by depth plus 600, adding a centre offset passed in as a parameter, and writes the resulting 2D coordinates into an output array.

name: store_two_words_from_globals
description: Calls one other routine, then stores two 16-bit words taken from a global data area at the destination address held in an address register.

name: offset_records_by_scaled_value
description: Adds scaled multiples of one value to three fields of each record in a 16-bit table over three passes, and sets three flag bytes by testing a computed value against minus 500.

name: emit_stepped_coordinate_pairs
description: Walks a pair of 16-bit tables, writing coordinate pairs offset by plus or minus 30 for each step, and continues while a called routine returns a nonzero value.

name: project_sixty_records_perspective
description: Sets loop counts from a mode argument, optionally copies three-word entries through called routines, then either clears three flag bytes when a global value is below minus 469 or projects a table of sixty records to 2D coordinates by dividing by depth plus 600.

name: call_one_routine_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out and produced no pseudo-code, so the body cannot be read; from the listing alone it has 22 instructions, is reached through a handler pointer, and makes one call to another routine.

name: transform_and_project_vertex_groups
description: Transforms groups of 3D vertices by adding and subtracting a scaled global value from their coordinates, then projects each vertex to 2D by dividing by depth plus 600, repeating over the list of groups until its counter expires.

name: copy_records_and_duplicate_entries
description: Copies 16-bit coordinate records from a table into an output buffer, pairing each with a value from a called routine, then duplicates six earlier entries and, when the argument is nonzero, fills further entries with a global value offset by 300.

name: store_argument_low_word
description: Stores the low 16-bit word of its argument into a fixed global variable and returns.

name: select_four_flag_offsets
description: Tests four bits of its argument and, for each set bit, replaces a default constant with an alternative value; it writes the resulting values into several global locations and sets four flag bytes to match.

name: store_inputs_boundary_difference
description: Saves two 16-bit inputs into global variables, then stores a value derived from their differences to four boundary globals, each difference doubled, into another global.

name: compute_boundary_difference_value
description: Computes a value from the differences between two inputs and four boundary globals, each doubled, and stores it in a global variable.

name: clip_point_first_edges
description: Tests the edge flag bits of a point and, for the flagged edges, computes the crossing coordinate by a scaled division; it returns the crossing when the result lies within the edge's boundary range and otherwise returns the original value.

name: clip_point_remaining_edges
description: Tests the edge-two flag and then the four and eight edge flags of a point, computing a crossing coordinate by scaled division for each flagged edge and returning it when it lies within the boundary range, otherwise returning the original value.

name: clip_point_last_edge_pair
description: Tests the four and eight edge flags of a point and, for the flagged edge, computes the crossing coordinate by scaled division, returning the crossing when it lies within the boundary range and otherwise the original value.

name: stub_no_operation_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it performs no work; it is an empty routine with no effect.

name: draw_clipped_line_bitplanes
description: Clips a line segment's endpoints with called routines, then draws it into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, setting one pixel bit per step and filling horizontal spans with per-plane colour bytes.

name: draw_line_stored_endpoints
description: Takes its endpoints from stored globals, clips them with called routines, and draws the resulting line into four bitplanes, setting pixel bits and filling horizontal spans with per-plane colour bytes.

name: draw_line_bitplanes_direct
description: Draws a line between two supplied endpoints into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, setting pixel bits along the major axis and filling horizontal spans with per-plane colour bytes, without calling clipping routines.

name: fill_pixel_column_bitplanes
description: Sets one pixel bit in each of four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart for a vertical run of rows, stepping through the bitplane buffer by a row pitch taken from the arguments.

name: set_pixel_column_from_pointer
description: Sets one pixel bit in each of four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart for a vertical run of rows, starting at a buffer address passed in an address register and stepping by a row pitch.

name: draw_slanted_line_bitplanes
description: Draws a sloped line into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, stepping along the major axis and advancing the row whenever a minor-axis error term is used up, setting one pixel bit per step.

name: draw_slanted_line_at_pointer
description: Draws a sloped line into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, starting from a buffer address passed in an address register and advancing rows with an error term that tracks the minor axis.

name: fill_horizontal_span_bitplanes
description: Sets pixel bits for a horizontal run across four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, writing partial bits at the ends and filling whole bytes in between with per-plane colour bytes taken from globals.

name: fill_horizontal_span_at_pointer
description: Sets pixel bits for a horizontal run across four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, starting at a buffer address passed in an address register, filling whole bytes with per-plane colour bytes and partial bits at the ends.

name: draw_sloped_span_bitplanes
description: Draws a sloped line into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart by plotting short runs of pixels on each row, advancing one row at a time and shifting the run across columns according to an error term.

name: draw_sloped_span_at_pointer
description: Draws a sloped line into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart by plotting short runs of pixels row by row, starting from a buffer address passed in an address register and using an error term to step across columns.

name: store_pair_then_call_routine
description: Stores the two 16-bit halves of its argument into two global variables and then calls another routine.

name: store_pair_return_registers
description: Stores the two 16-bit halves of its argument into two global variables, calls another routine, and returns the incoming data registers unchanged.

name: plot_pixel_if_in_bounds
description: Plots one pixel into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, but only when the point lies inside a rectangle given by four limit globals; the row address is computed at 40 bytes per row.

name: set_pixel_bit_four_planes
description: Sets one pixel bit, selected by a bit number from a data register, at a buffer address in four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: clear_display_longwords_backward
description: Zeroes 32-bit words in display memory by writing backward from a row address computed from two globals, using an unrolled sequence inside a nested loop; the decompiled listing is truncated, so only the start of the clearing sequence is evident.

name: call_table_quotient_sequence
description: Runs a sequence of indirect calls through a global jump table, each passing the quotient of a table entry divided by a value from an earlier call, with fixed loops of thirty, fifteen and nineteen steps.

name: project_strip_quads_and_plot
description: Projects up to twenty-four 3D points by perspective division with depth plus 600, expands each into a strip of four coordinate pairs in a buffer, then calls another routine for each buffered point that lies within the horizontal bounds.

name: print_menu_labels_fixed_positions
description: Calls a sequence of routines with fixed coordinate pairs, then indirect routines; the referenced text includes select a death star, easy, medium, hard, wave 1, wave 3, wave 5, bonus and no bonus, so it lays out labels at fixed positions.

name: update_countdown_select_mode
description: Converts a timer global into a countdown digit character, draws the countdown text at fixed positions, then polls an input value to choose one of three modes, storing the choice and resetting a flag; if no choice is made it draws a fixed sequence of symbols instead.

name: run_prompt_state_loop
description: Draws two positioned text items, then runs a three-state loop until the state reaches its end value, drawing the prompt text that tells the player to pull the trigger to start; the loop is preceded and followed by display-pointer swaps.

name: wait_frames_until_state_change
description: Runs up to 500 frame iterations while a state variable stays zero, calling update routines on each pass; afterwards it returns minus one if the state is still zero, otherwise a flag showing whether the state is not four.

name: build_point_table_from_lookup
description: Builds a table of 128 points by passing each source value through two indirect lookup calls, shifting the results right, adding offsets of 100 and 2000, and storing the pairs in an output buffer, then calls another routine.

name: draw_credit_text_lines
description: Draws the publisher credit, the Amiga version credit, the title text and one further element at fixed positions, using the referenced text lines as the displayed strings.

name: draw_intro_crawl_lines
description: Draws eight lines of the opening text at successive vertical offsets from a base row, using the referenced lines about the Empire, the rebel planet and Obi-Wan Kenobi, then draws one further element at a computed position.

name: stub_timeout_forty_seven
description: The decompiler timed out and produced no pseudo-code, so the body cannot be read; the listing shows 47 instructions and two callers, and nothing more can be said of its behaviour.

name: offset_point_table_lookup
description: Derives two offsets from a fixed-point lookup, adds them to each of 128 entries in a point table, and writes a pair of global words into an output buffer for each entry; it also increments a global when its argument exceeds ten and has its low two bits set.

name: stub_timeout_thirty_instructions
description: The decompiler timed out and produced no pseudo-code, so the body cannot be read; the listing shows 30 instructions and a single caller, and nothing more can be said of its behaviour.

name: draw_shape_vertex_pairs
description: Passes many coordinate pairs from a shape table to indirect drawing routines, offsetting the second value of each pair by a global, so that the table is drawn as an outline; it is preceded by calls that set up the drawing state.

name: run_timed_scroll_sequence
description: Runs three timed sequences of frames, each waiting for the frame counter to advance while calling update routines; one pass steps a value from 100 down to minus 200, another from minus 50 up to 200, and a third from 100 down past minus 370, returning early with a nonzero state code if one is raised.

name: classify_phase_from_counter
description: Calls a routine with its argument, then returns a phase code: 1 when a counter is below 20 and the mode is not one, 0 or 3 depending on a flag when the counter is below 300 or the mode is two, and 2 otherwise.

name: update_particle_records_respawn
description: Updates seventy three-word records by adding a velocity to each position, respawning a record with random values when it crosses a limit, and calls a drawing routine for each record; the argument selects whether the vertical or horizontal limits are tested.

name: randomize_seventy_particle_records
description: Fills seventy three-word records with random values, storing the high byte of two random numbers as positions and a value from one to eight as a speed.

name: draw_briefing_text_by_mode
description: Selects a display position from a mode number between zero and sixteen, then draws the matching briefing text line through a text routine; the referenced text covers the X-Wing shields, deflector strength, Trench Turrets, the Death Star and the flight instructions.

name: draw_scoring_table_labels
description: Draws a scoring table of target names, including Tie Fighters, Laser Towers, Laser Bunkers, Trench Turrets, Exhaust Port and Darth Vader Ship, with their point values such as 1,000, 2,000, 25,000 and 50,000, at fixed row offsets, then draws one final element.

name: run_scene_frames_stepping
description: Runs up to 768 frames of a scene, stepping a position parameter by 256 every five frames and calling update routines each frame; it stops early and returns a nonzero code if an input routine reports one.

name: run_scene_frames_stepping_copy
description: Runs up to 768 frames of a scene with the same stepping loop as its sibling routine, stepping a position parameter by 256 every five frames and returning early with a nonzero code when an input routine reports one.

name: run_scene_frames_descending
description: Runs a scene for frames while a position counter descends from 110 to just above minus 360, stepping a second parameter, calling update routines each frame, and returning early with a nonzero code when an input routine reports one.

name: store_word_in_slot_table
description: Stores the second 16-bit word of its argument into one of sixteen word slots, the slot being chosen by the low four bits of the first word.

name: wait_until_frame_count
description: Resets a frame counter global to zero, then loops until the counter reaches the value passed in the argument.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Computes the integer square root of its 16-bit argument by Newton-style iteration, starting from the argument divided by 200 plus 2 and refining the estimate by division until it stops changing.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it performs no work; it is an empty routine with no effect.

name: set_default_small_bounds
description: Sets three global values to 15, minus 15 and 15, which act as small limit values for later drawing or clipping.

name: set_default_screen_bounds
description: Sets six global values to fixed limits: 160 and 115 as dimensions, horizontal bounds from minus 160 to 159, and vertical bounds from minus 84 to 84, which define the drawing area.

name: advance_depth_records_direction
description: Moves thirty-one three-word records along depth by subtracting a speed argument, adding 14500 to any record that drops below minus 500 or whose depth passes the range in the other direction, and draws each record through called routines when a depth test passes.

name: advance_depth_records_counted
description: Moves a counted run of three-word records along depth by a speed value, wrapping any record that leaves the lower depth range by adding 14500, and draws each record through called routines when a depth test passes.

name: advance_depth_records_positive
description: Moves thirty-one three-word records along depth by subtracting a speed value, wrapping each record that exceeds 14000 by subtracting 14500, and draws each one through called routines when a depth test passes.

name: advance_depth_records_counted_wrap
description: Moves a counted run of three-word records along depth by subtracting a speed value, wrapping any record above 14000 by subtracting 14500, and draws each record through called routines when a depth test passes.

name: advance_records_with_rotation
description: Moves thirty-one three-word records along depth, flipping the sign of their two velocity words when they wrap; when the argument is positive it also adds a scaled global offset to the two position words, wrapping them within a 4096 range, and draws each record.

name: advance_rotating_records_counted
description: Moves a counted run of three-word records along depth by subtracting a speed value, flipping the sign of their velocity words when they wrap, adding two offsets and masking the position words within a 4096 range, then draws each record.

name: advance_depth_records_mirrored
description: Moves thirty-one three-word records along depth by subtracting a speed value, wrapping any record above 14000 by subtracting 14500 and flipping the sign of its two velocity words, then draws each record through a called routine.

name: advance_counted_records_mirrored
description: Moves a counted run of three-word records along depth by subtracting a speed value, wrapping any record above 14000 by subtracting 14500 and flipping the sign of its two velocity words, then draws each record through a called routine.

name: sync_frame_and_draw_pair
description: Resets the frame counter, calls two routines with its argument and then two further routines, and waits until at least one frame has passed before returning.

name: call_single_table_routine
description: Calls one routine through a jump table and returns, with no other work.

name: remove_expired_list_entries
description: Walks backward through a list of six-byte entries, calling a routine for each entry whose key is at least the argument and reducing a count by six, then stores the new list end.

name: spawn_list_entry_when_ready
description: Advances through a list of entries while their keys stay above a threshold; when a free entry and a random test allow, it initialises the entry from a fixed table, sets a flag and returns minus one, otherwise it returns zero.

name: insert_sorted_list_entry
description: Finds the insertion point for a key in a sorted list of six-byte entries, increments the list count, moves the later entries with a block-move routine, and returns the address of the new slot.

name: build_entry_projection_buffer
description: Converts each entry of a depth-sorted list into a three-word output record holding two global values and a perspective scale of 25600 divided by depth plus 600, and draws each record when the argument is nonzero.

name: update_particle_list_expire
description: Moves each entry of a particle list by subtracting a speed, applying two velocity words to its coordinates with wrapping within a 4096 range, then removes entries that have passed the depth or vertical limits by calling a removal routine.

name: draw_six_point_ring_shape
description: Derives three scaled offsets from a rotation-style table and draws a six-point ring of segments around a centre point, drawing each segment through called plotting routines; a negative argument selects a variant that sets a colour for each segment.

name: update_difficulty_parameters
description: Derives three parameters from a level counter, capping them at fixed values once the counter reaches seven, then calls one routine and increments the counter up to 99.

name: stub_timeout_ten_instructions
description: The decompiler timed out and produced no pseudo-code, so the body cannot be read; the listing shows 10 instructions, a pointer reference and a single caller, and nothing more can be said of its behaviour.

name: send_word_sequence_to_routine
description: Passes each 16-bit word of a table to a called routine in turn, advancing the table pointer and stopping after the count supplied in a data register, then returns the next table address.

name: call_two_routines_with_arguments
description: Passes its two arguments to two separate called routines, one each, and returns.

name: call_eleven_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls one routine eleven times in succession, with no other work, and returns.

name: run_timed_main_loop
description: Clears position and speed globals, then runs up to 1500 frames, drawing each frame through called routines and reducing a speed value by 250 while it exceeds 1000; it then waits for pending items to clear and finishes with a final call.

name: run_frame_loop_until_flag
description: Repeats frame updates through called routines, reducing a speed value by 250 while it exceeds 1000, until a status routine returns nonzero, a flag is set or 1500 frames pass; it then clears the flag and waits for pending items to clear.

name: wait_for_pending_items_clear
description: Clears a flag, repeatedly calls a routine until it returns zero and the flag is zero, then makes one final call with a global argument.

name: draw_zigzag_marks_scaled
description: Draws a zigzag pattern of short segments whose length scales with its argument, moving between fixed offsets from a centre point through called plotting routines.

name: draw_shield_status_display
description: Draws the shield status by choosing one of three bar settings from the shield value, drawing either the shield text or the shield gone text, decrementing a blink counter, and then drawing the remaining status element.

name: adjust_shield_value_state
description: When the state is one, adds its argument to a shield value; a negative argument instead resets a set of counters and returns if the shield value is depleted, otherwise it loads a countdown from the shield value and sets a display step of ten.

name: start_shield_countdown
description: Copies the shield value into a countdown state, sets a fixed step of ten, adds a value from a caller-supplied record to the shield value, and calls one routine.

name: handle_pause_command_code
description: Handles a command code: 64 pauses the game by clearing pending input, saving a state byte, drawing the Game Paused text and waiting for input before restoring; 80 and 81 set and clear a flag, and 82 toggles a byte.

name: draw_status_overlay_shapes
description: Draws status overlay symbols, choosing between two line shapes by a state value and toggling a small shape pattern on each frame, then draws two decrementing counter markers and a fixed outline at positions relative to a base row.

name: draw_status_overlay_store_result
description: Draws the status overlay: in state three it toggles a small shape pattern, decrements two counter markers, draws a fixed outline, then stores a called routine's result in a record and calls another routine when it is nonzero.

name: draw_fixed_shape_overlay_store
description: Draws a small fixed shape at a position passed in a data register, decrements two counter markers, draws a fixed outline, then stores a called routine's result and calls another routine when it is nonzero.

name: draw_counter_outline_overlay
description: Draws one fixed symbol at a fixed position, decrements a counter marker, draws a fixed outline, then stores a called routine's result and calls another routine when it is nonzero.

name: draw_outline_store_result
description: Draws a fixed symbol and a fixed outline at positions relative to a base row, then stores a called routine's result in a record and calls another routine when it is nonzero.

name: update_damped_motion_values
description: Derives a display offset from a counter and a direction flag, then moves two motion values toward target inputs with damping, clamping them to fixed limits; when a flag is set it resets a countdown timer, toggles a byte and calls a routine.

name: update_damped_motion_setup
description: Stores two derived values in a record, computes a scaled difference, sets three lookup values, damps two motion values with clamping, and when a flag is set resets a timer, toggles a byte and calls a routine.

name: damp_motion_values_clamped
description: Clamps one motion value to at most 270, doubles and clamps another to within plus or minus 320, damps both toward target values, and when a flag is set resets a countdown and toggles a byte.

name: damp_motion_upper_clamp
description: Clamps a motion value to at most 320, damps two motion values toward target values, and when a flag is set resets a countdown and toggles a byte.

name: reset_countdown_and_call
description: Sets a countdown timer to seven and calls one routine with a zero argument.

name: draw_packed_digit_string
description: Draws up to eight digits taken from successive four-bit groups of a 32-bit value, calling a digit routine for each one and placing a separator before every fourth digit.

name: tick_timer_flash_message
description: Decrements a countdown timer and, when it reaches zero, draws a message at a fixed position twice with a display buffer swap in between, then calls another routine.

name: draw_timed_message_block
description: Draws two fixed text items on a fixed row, starts a countdown of ten, then draws a further fixed-size block at a fixed position through a buffer copy routine.

name: draw_count_symbols_block
description: Draws one or two copies of a symbol depending on a count byte, then draws a fixed-size block at a position in the display area.

name: draw_two_digit_count_symbols
description: Draws one or two copies of a symbol depending on whether its argument is at least ten, then draws a fixed-size block at a fixed position.

name: draw_five_offset_markers
description: Derives a scale and a centre offset from two position values, then draws five markers at offset positions taken from tables, placing each through a routine that draws it at the given coordinates.

name: build_angle_lookup_tables
description: Advances a base angle by 120 and fills several 16-bit tables from two indirect lookup calls: six entries at successive offsets of 120 plus a few fixed entries, with the second table taking the other lookup's results.

name: plot_points_decreasing_steps
description: Plots points at a fixed height of 250 across the horizontal range, with the horizontal step shrinking through the sequence 46, 36, 25, 18, 11, 7 and 4, calling a plot routine for each point.

name: draw_glyph_by_code
description: Draws a small glyph chosen by a code from zero to nine, plotting a fixed sequence of points relative to a position and updating two cursor values for each stroke.

name: draw_vector_text_string
description: Draws a zero-terminated string one character at a time from a vector glyph table, advancing the cursor by a width for each space and plotting the strokes of each glyph through called routines.

name: pick_random_entry_and_draw
description: Chooses a random entry from a table of three-byte records within up to thirty attempts, then draws it as a text string or a glyph depending on its code, using a buffer when a flag bit is set; it also draws a fixed entry when a counter exceeds two.

name: process_initials_key_input
description: Handles one key code for an initials entry field of up to three characters: a letter or space is appended while there is room, code 3 removes the last character, code 2 adds a space, and other codes are rejected; it returns minus one while a frame counter is below 1501 and zero otherwise.

name: draw_counter_text_item
description: Derives a horizontal position from a counter, draws a text item through a lookup call, then clears a flag and calls one routine when the state flag was set.

name: draw_high_score_table
description: Draws a table of ten rows with rank numbers, initials and scores in formatted fields, highlighting the row of a new entry and drawing messages from the referenced text; when a new entry is pending it reads initials through a key-input routine, otherwise it waits for about 500 frames.

name: insert_random_total_into_table
description: Sums nine values from a random-number routine, then inserts the total into a ten-entry sorted table by shifting lower entries down, and calls one routine after placing it.

name: insert_shifted_total_into_table
description: Accumulates values from a random-number routine while shifting a running value right by four bits on each pass, then inserts the total into the same ten-entry sorted table and calls one routine.

name: insert_into_sorted_table_tail
description: Scans down a ten-entry table for the first entry the total is not below, shifts the remaining entries down with a block-move routine, stores the total in the freed slot, and calls one routine.

name: open_system_libraries_setup
description: Opens system libraries and creates device and timer request structures through library vector calls, setting their fields and issuing requests; it calls an error routine whenever an open or allocation returns zero.

name: clear_flag_and_call_library
description: Clears a global variable to zero and calls one routine with a fixed 32-bit constant, which is a library vector call at a fixed offset from a loaded library base.

name: setup_disk_dma_read_track
description: Clears bits in a drive control block, writes the standard disk sync word and disk DMA and control register values, polls a status bit for up to 125000 iterations, then advances the buffer past any further sync words.

name: reset_level_state_draw_hints
description: Resets scoring, timer and motion globals for a new round, sets a speed-dependent value from the level counter, and when a flag is set draws the Shoot Fireballs and Shoot Tie-Fighters hint text at fixed positions.

name: advance_records_by_rotation_offsets
description: Moves thirty-one three-word records along depth by subtracting a fixed step, flipping velocity signs when a record wraps, rotating its two position words by offsets masked to a 4096 range, and draws each record through a called routine.

name: randomize_object_position_fields
description: Fills three position fields of an object record with values from two lookup calls, each shifted right by two bits, after applying a fixed offset to a size field.

name: spawn_random_object_slot
description: When the object count is below its limit and a timer threshold is met, claims the next record, fills its position and velocity from random values, sets its lifetime and flags, and draws a lookup entry for that lifetime.

name: update_active_object_list
description: Updates each active object in a list: counts down its timers, moves it by its velocity, applies random speed and shot adjustments when timers expire, and removes it from the list when it passes the lower depth limit, then updates the list-level state.

name: launch_object_projectiles
description: For each active object inside the target bounds, when a random roll passes, claims a free projectile record and sets its position, a direction flag and velocity components scaled by the object's distance.

name: call_alternating_pair_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of thirteen calls that alternate between two routines, with no other work, and returns the incoming data registers unchanged.

name: draw_record_outline_shape
description: Draws a fixed outline shape by stepping through points taken from an object record's coordinate fields, plotting them with two routines, and then draws a short second stroke.

name: draw_object_sprite_strokes
description: Draws an object's sprite from flags in its record: one or two strokes offset from a base position, then, when a further flag is set, four blocks of five values and five more entries through called routines.

name: check_object_hits_and_draw
description: Checks each active object against target bounds and a random chance; on a hit it reduces the object count, plays a hit effect through a call and adjusts its timers, then updates the list pointers and draws each object.

name: remove_random_object_in_range
description: Scans the object list for the first record within the depth and screen bounds that passes two random tests, removes it by moving the rest of the list down, decrements the count and calls a routine.

name: update_hud_counters_and_flags
description: Derives display values from two status globals and sets two lookup values; once the level counter reaches 100 it subtracts scaled rates from two running counters, and when a flag is set it toggles a byte, resets a countdown and calls a routine.

name: draw_timed_marker_blink
description: While a flag is set and a frame counter is below 320, draws a small marker whose vertical position depends on a status bit, then advances the counter.

name: draw_score_readout_values
description: Draws a score or status readout: below level 111 it draws a value from a lookup with a decreasing offset, and otherwise it converts two running totals into lookup values and draws the resulting figure at a fixed position.

name: draw_active_object_markers
description: Draws one marker for each active object at a fixed level of 300, using each object's stored value for position and stepping through the object records.

name: run_round_until_end
description: Runs frames of a round while a state flag is zero and a timer stays non-negative, waiting for each frame to pass; when the state flag is set it performs an end-of-round action, clears a pending flag, and returns the state flag value.

name: scale_lookup_by_shift
description: Passes its argument to one lookup call, takes a second lookup of the constant 10000, shifts that result right by 13 bits, and returns the value.

name: call_single_routine_passthrough
description: Calls one routine and returns with no other work.

name: append_pair_to_buffer
description: Appends its two 16-bit halves as two longword entries to a buffer, advancing the buffer pointer by eight bytes.

name: build_geometry_table_entries
description: Fills a table of longword pairs from lookup calls: thirty-one pairs stepped by 48, ten further entries, then sixteen pairs stepped by 96 that receive offsets of 7500 and minus 10000, followed by twenty-one routine calls with fixed constants.

name: initialise_random_record_table_spread
description: Initialises thirty-one three-word records with a horizontal position starting at minus 259 and stepping by 483 per record, and random vertical and depth values each shifted right by 12 bits.

name: delay_after_ten_calls
description: Calls one routine ten times with the same global argument, then spins in a countdown loop of two million iterations before returning.

name: clear_and_load_shape_records
description: Clears the first longword of six records, then calls a loader six times with the addresses of those records; the referenced file names are laser, nose and star shape files.

name: load_resource_into_record
description: Looks up a resource by identifier through a library call, stores the returned handle and a word argument in a record, obtains the resource size, and calls another routine to load it.

name: load_sound_assets_pack_digits
description: Loads the sound and music resources by name, including the Death Star, exhaust, hit, laser and missile sounds and the music file, clears an eleven-entry table, and converts an eight-character number into four packed-decimal bytes.

name: allocate_buffers_init_tables
description: Clears a set of global pointers, allocates buffers of 32000, 4000, 1000 and 800 bytes through a memory routine, and fills a sixteen-word table with fixed values that include pairs of repeated nibbles.

name: read_line_with_return_prompt
description: Clears a 31-entry input buffer, reads up to eighty characters through a library call, draws the prompt lines that mention the Return key and a list, and returns.

name: reset_game_state_globals
description: Sets a large set of game globals to defaults, including speed and position values, a wave value of 17 and a timer of eight, clears a 31-entry table, then calls routines to reset the display area.

name: draw_score_wave_headers
description: Sets game flags and resets two counters, then draws the score and wave headers through called routines, clearing a status area and drawing two further labels at a fixed position.

name: wait_for_input_event_loop
description: Loops reading input events through called routines until one of them returns zero, then calls a finishing routine and returns, polling a second set of inputs while it waits.

name: load_image_record_from_file
description: Opens a resource by identifier, reads a ten-byte header to derive width, height and data size, allocates a buffer, reads the image data into it, closes the resource, and fills a record with the size, offsets and buffer pointers.

name: load_sprite_planes_with_masks
description: Loads a sprite resource and rearranges its rows into interleaved bitplane buffers, writing an all-ones mask word before each row and filling the mask and plane buffers for every sprite row.

name: blit_clipped_masked_sprite
description: Clips a sprite against the screen bounds, then programs the blitter control and size registers for a masked copy of its bitplanes with the computed modulo values, waiting for the blitter to be free before each start.

name: load_sound_sample_tables
description: Loads the trumpet sound resource, builds five sample pointer and length tables, fills a table with twelve note period values and twelve random values, and fills a 120-entry table with scaled lookup results.

name: locate_sample_chunks_in_file
description: Reads a chunked resource and walks its chunk headers, skipping odd-length padding, to record the data pointers and sizes of two sample chunks.

name: advance_music_channel_tick
description: Runs one music tick for two channels: when a channel's counter expires it reads the next two sequence bytes, sets the period and volume from the note table and starts a sample with a duration from a lookup table, otherwise it decrements the counter.

name: play_music_note_channel_zero
description: Handles one note event for audio channel zero: for a non-rest note it looks up the sample address, length and period, programs the channel's address, length, period and volume registers, pauses briefly, and then advances the channel timing and reads the next sequence bytes.

name: advance_music_sequence_tick
description: Advances the music sequence timer: when it reaches zero it reads the next two sequence bytes and sets the following event duration from a lookup table, otherwise it decrements the timer and writes a short follow-up value to the channel registers.

name: play_music_note_channel_one
description: Handles one note event for audio channel one: for a non-rest note it looks up a period in the note table and programs the channel's length, period and volume registers, then computes the note duration from a lookup table.

name: set_channel_one_short_length
description: When a timer is below three, writes a length and a volume value to the registers of audio channel one, otherwise does nothing.

name: initialise_music_playback
description: Resets both music sequence pointers to their starts, clears the timer and duration globals, enables the audio DMA channels and interrupts, and marks playback as active.

name: stop_music_playback
description: Writes a value of three to an output global and clears the playback-active flag, which stops music output.

name: set_playback_active_flag
description: Sets the playback-active flag to one, so that the music routines treat playback as running.

name: read_playback_active_flag
description: Returns the current value of the playback-active flag.

name: map_code_to_routine_result
description: Takes a code and calls one routine for the codes 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12 and 19, returning that routine's result; for any other code it returns the code minus 19 without calling anything.

name: initialise_round_state_and_layout
description: Resets round state, derives scoring values from a level counter, fills 26 records with random positions, loads a level layout from a table, counts marker entries, and for later levels draws the tower-clearing bonus text and status shapes at fixed positions.

name: update_and_compact_entry_list
description: Moves each entry in a list by a speed and an acceleration, adds a random jitter to some entries, then removes entries that fall below a threshold by compacting the list.

name: scroll_entry_ring_respawn
description: Scrolls a ring of records by a random step, appends a fresh record when the leading record passes a threshold, rotates a five-entry group between two sets, and periodically refreshes a pattern table from a stored list.

name: generate_row_entries_both_sides
description: Generates entries for five rows by scanning from each side of the screen and placing an entry wherever a random test passes, storing its position, type and a value derived from its depth.

name: draw_typed_object_pieces
description: Draws an object according to its type code through a sequence of plotting calls, then for each of four sub-parts within depth range projects a point and draws that part at the computed scale.

name: spawn_marked_entries_from_list
description: For each entry of a type below three that is not already marked, when a random test passes, marks it and creates a new entry at an offset position within the list's range.

name: check_entry_hits_and_draw
description: Checks the entries of a list against a target position and type, and on a hit marks the entry, plays a sound effect through a call and sets a flag; it then draws the entries at their positions.

name: claim_nearby_entry_when_clear
description: Walks the list of records and removes the first one ahead of a threshold that passes two random tests, starting a timer; when a flag is clear it also scans for a secondary condition on the remaining records.

name: update_scroll_offset_and_lookup
description: Adjusts a scroll offset that eases toward a target or accelerates while a flag is active, then looks up two values at that offset and stores them as scaled offsets.

name: update_scroll_velocity_damped
description: Sets motion globals from a level counter, damps a velocity value toward a target, and when a flag is set toggles a byte, resets a countdown and calls a routine.

name: draw_blinking_indicator
description: Draws a blinking indicator at a fixed position: when a timer is not running it draws a symbol on alternate frames, otherwise it chooses one of two symbols from a status bit, and it advances the frame counter.

name: draw_frame_with_optional_overlay
description: Draws the background and foreground layers through called routines, then draws two overlay items when the level is above two, a counter is below 500 and a flag is clear, and finishes with a final call.

name: run_wave_intro_sequence
description: Returns zero on the first level; on later levels it runs a sweep of frames while a position value exceeds 5000, easing a scroll value and drawing each frame, then waits for a frame condition, draws two items, and returns the flag value.

name: project_two_depth_offsets
description: Divides two stored 32-bit values by two depth-dependent denominators offset by 470 and 730 units, and stores the four 16-bit quotients in globals.

name: project_offset_pair_by_depth
description: Divides the argument offset by 30720 above and below, using two depth-dependent denominators offset by 470 and 730 units, and stores the four quotients in globals.

name: project_triple_values_by_depth
description: Divides three stored 32-bit values by two depth-dependent denominators offset by 450 and 750 units, storing the six quotients in globals.

name: project_offset_triple_wide
description: Divides the argument by denominators derived from a depth value to compute two quotients offset by plus and minus 46080 and a third quotient, storing the three results in globals.

name: draw_tactical_hint_text
description: Draws hint text lines chosen by the level, including Use the Force, Exhaust Port Ahead, Exhaust Port Missed and Avoid Catwalks, then draws a block of cells that cycles through three marker values.

name: initialise_column_positions
description: Resets scroll and count state, points two list pointers at their buffers, and fills eleven column slots with increasing positions stepped by 1900, each paired with a second value 950 further on.

name: scroll_column_list_tick
description: Scrolls eleven column positions and a set of records, recycling the first column off the left edge by shifting the list and appending a new column 1900 further along, updates two projection values from a rotation global, and compacts records that have left the screen.

name: draw_column_tile_pattern
description: Draws a vertical column of tiles between two rows derived from a mode value, plotting sixteen-entry tile patterns through lookup and plot calls for each row.

name: show_bonus_score_screen
description: Draws the end-of-wave bonus screen with the referenced lines about the Death Star being destroyed, starting bonus points, shield bonus and shield strength, builds a bonus line from the shield count, flashes the display over several timed frames, then clears it.

name: test_shot_hit_region
description: Tests whether a shot lies within a target box for the flagged regions, and on a hit clears the active flag, toggles a status byte, calls a hit routine and starts a sound effect.

name: draw_shape_by_code
description: Draws one of three marker shapes chosen by a code, plotting a fixed sequence of points around the stored marker coordinates: code twelve draws a longer pattern, code eight a short four-point box, and other codes a standard box.

name: draw_masked_nibble_markers
description: Walks the four-bit groups of a mask and draws a marker pair for each group with its low bits set, moving down the column by a fixed step per group and returning the last drawn value.

name: set_status_colour_and_copy
description: Sets a colour value from a global, copies four display coordinate globals into saved slots, and sets a status colour from the wave counter, using a fixed value once the counter exceeds nine.

name: check_trigger_target_hits
description: Checks the target flags of the current entry against a range test and a random chance; when a flag bit matches and the position is inside the shot window, it sets a state value, plays a sound through a call and marks the entry as hit, then updates the active flag.

name: draw_moving_target_sprites
description: Draws moving target sprites and their trailing strokes at computed positions, advancing their timers, playing a sound effect and spawning a new marker when a random test passes.

name: process_entries_below_threshold
description: Repeatedly calls one routine for each list entry whose key is below the argument, advancing the list pointers past each one.

name: spawn_lane_entries_check_hits
description: Spawns new list entries in left and right lanes when random tests pass and the state allows, rebuilds the table of entry positions, then checks each entry for a hit within a window and, on a hit, clears the flag and plays a sound effect.

name: draw_periodic_marker_sprites
description: Draws marker sprites at fixed positions chosen by a status flag and level counters, using a timing counter so the markers appear on a rhythm, with a third marker drawn when a flag is set.

name: draw_trench_frame_entries
description: Draws the trench frame: plots two rows of marker strokes, draws lane markers from a counter, then walks the list of six entries drawing hits and each entry in range through called routines, and rebuilds the list pointers.

name: draw_projected_wireframe_frame
description: Projects a wireframe of fifty-seven vertex pairs from stored rotation values into screen coordinates, scaling each vertex by depth, then plots the wireframe segments through called routines.

name: animate_sweep_steps
description: Steps an animation parameter from minus 720 up to zero, advancing by forty, twenty or twelve as it passes thresholds, and in each step sets a value from a random routine, draws a frame and waits for a frame to pass.

name: run_frames_until_flag
description: Runs frames, each drawing through called routines and waiting for a frame, until a hit flag or a status flag is set; it then clears the sequence state and sets the end flag when no further hit is pending.

name: run_display_loop_until_flag
description: Repeats a display and wait cycle, alternating between two display routines according to a level counter, until an input or status flag is set; it then clears a pending flag and returns the status value.
